name: Image Sizes Defaults
description: Add some default for image sizes.
project_description: Optional submodule of Image Sizes. Installs a ready-made set of image_sizes presets (Default, Landscape, Portrait) together with their core image styles, so a container-responsive image ladder is available immediately without hand-building styles or running the Drush generator. Landscape and Portrait use scale-and-crop styles at fixed aspect ratios; every preset ships a blurred low-res WebP preload style. Requires the image_effects module for the gaussian-blur placeholder effect.
